stepBody:
Suppose we use the following regression model with a single model weight $$	heta$$ and loss function:
$$f_{	heta}(x)=\sigma(	heta-2)$$
$$l(	heta,x,y)=-y\log{f_{	heta}(x)}-(1-y)\log(1-f_{	heta}(x))+ rac{1}{2}	heta**{2}$$
Derive the stochastic gradient descent update rule for this model and loss function, assuming that the learning rate $$\alpha=1$$
Your answer may only use the variables $$	heta**{(t+1)}$$ and $$	heta**{(t)}$$ and $$y$$ and the sigmoid function $$\sigma.$$
